items.quote: Excellent work done by second 2 none trapping! Cj was super polite and knowledgeable about helping me get some critters out of my parents old home. He took his time to seal off all entry points, and gave me great advice about better protecting my home. Will definitely recommend to others!

It was a pleasure doing business with Cj, he's knowledgeable, fast and efficient. Got rid of some bee's that were trying to make a nest in my roof, and even sealed the hole! Usually the person I'd recommend to my friends if they need to humanely get rid of critters and what not.

I had ants in my house (little sugar ants) and no matter what I did I couldn't get rid of them. I found Second 2 None by chance and the owner came out to my house and treated my problem. One week later I couldn't find a single ant anywhere.
